description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of Certificate of Exemption to Edifice Castle Management Corporation w.e.f. 15.09,2016 to 15.09.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). It concerns the issuance of a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution, which falls under the category of regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements. This is a Legal/Regulatory matter, not a government personnel/structure change or any other specialized category.
